title: Goodbye, My Rose Garden
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In early-1900s England, aspiring Japanese novelist Hanako Kujo hopes to meet her favorite author and instead becomes lady's maid to the noblewoman Alice Douglas. Alice, pressured into an arranged marriage and haunted by rumors of an affair with her former governess, promises Hanako an introduction on one condition: that Hanako kill her. Trying to understand why, Hanako grows close to Alice, and the story ends with the two leaving the confines of their 'rose garden' together (Wikipedia; ANN Manga Guide; Seven Seas blurb).
life_message: Love that society forbids can still be lived honestly, and despair can give way to a life chosen together.

content.note: Request to be killed is talk, not act, per summaries.
